description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Repository Skaab from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Repository Skaab, untapping the basic Swamp.
Resolve the Repository Skaab ability, sacrificing it.
Repository Skaab's second ability triggers, returning an instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
